title: Knockdown
description: This creature takes damage from other players [blue]multiplied by the knockdown counter[/blue] this turn.
smart_description: Other allies deal [blue]increased damage multiplied by the knockdown counter[/blue] to this enemy this turn.
notes: Single-turn stacking debuff that removes itself at the end of the owner's turn. Multiplies damage taken from other players (excluding the player who applied this power). Only affects powered attacks.
